item.title: How to Install Python on Your System: A Guide
item.description: Learn how to install the latest Python version on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Check your version and choose the best installation method for your system.

item.title: Quiz: Python's tuple Data Type: A Deep Dive With Examples
item.description: Practice Python tuples: create, access, and unpack immutable sequences to write safer, clearer code. Reinforce basics and avoid common gotchas. Try the quiz.

item.title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #285: Exploring MCP Apps & Adding Interactive UIs to Clients
item.description: How can you move your MCP tools beyond plain text? How do you add interactive UI components directly inside chat conversations? This week on the show, Den Delimarsky from Anthropic joins us to discuss MCP Apps and interactive UIs in MCP.

item.title: Quiz: Build a Hash Table in Python With TDD
item.description: Learn how Python hashing spreads values into buckets and powers hash tables. Practice collisions, uniform distribution, and test-driven development.

item.title: Python for Loops: The Pythonic Way
item.description: Learn how to use Python for loops to iterate over lists, tuples, strings, and dictionaries with Pythonic looping techniques.

item.title: Start Building With FastAPI
item.description: Learn how to build APIs with FastAPI in Python, including Pydantic models, HTTP methods, CRUD operations, and interactive documentation.

item.title: How to Run Your Python Scripts and Code
item.description: Learn how to run Python scripts from the command line, REPL, IDEs, and file managers on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Master all execution approaches.

item.title: Quiz: Hands-On Python 3 Concurrency With the asyncio Module
item.description: Test your asyncio skills with a focused quiz on coroutines, event loops, generators, and IO-bound concurrency in Python 3.

item.title: Quiz: Dependency Management With Python Poetry
item.description: Test your knowledge of Python Poetry, from installation and virtual environments to lock files, dependency groups, and updates.

item.title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #286: Overcoming Testing Obstacles With Python's Mock Object Library
item.description: Do you have complex logic and unpredictable dependencies that make it hard to write reliable tests? How can you use Python's mock object library to improve your tests? Christopher Trudeau is back on the show this week with another batch of PyCoder's Weekly articles and projects.
